params.name: startDate
params.description: Unit Commitment End Date From. Any date from 2024-07-01. Default to current time if left blank (format: yyyy-MM-dd).)

params.name: endDate
params.description: Unit Commitment End Date To. Any date from 2024-07-01 but after startDate. If left blank, return all the data from startDate. (format: yyyy-MM-dd).)

items.docs: Fetch generating unit commitment directive data for a date range
